title: Practice 10: Which prefix? — the whole table, as practice

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Tom flew to Australia.
exercises.why: **улетел** — past tense (masculine) of улететь: perfective (imperfective partner: улетать).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: A mouse came into the room.
exercises.why: **вбежала** — past tense (feminine) of вбежать: perfective (imperfective partner: вбегать).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: Tom is going on tour.
exercises.why: **уезжает** — present tense (3rd person singular) of уезжать: imperfective (perfective partner: уехать).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: A cat came out from under the desk.
exercises.why: **вылез** — past tense (masculine) of вылезть: perfective (imperfective partner: вылезать).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: Tom converted to Catholicism.
exercises.why: **перешёл** — past tense (masculine) of перейти: perfective (imperfective partner: переходить).  Prefix **пере-**: movement across, from one point to another; through (через + acc.; without preposition + acc).

exercises.q: She gave me a ride home.
exercises.why: **довезла** — past tense (feminine) of довезти: perfective (imperfective partner: довозить).  Prefix **до-**: reaching a limit or destination (до + gen).

exercises.q: Let's go out on the terrace.
exercises.why: **выйдем** — future tense (1st person plural) of выйти: perfective (imperfective partner: выходить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: He's a little slow on the uptake.
exercises.why: **доходит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of доходить: imperfective (perfective partner: дойти).  Prefix **до-**: reaching a limit or destination (до + gen).

exercises.q: Tom drives Mary to school.
exercises.why: **отвозит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of отвозить: imperfective (perfective partner: отвезти).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).

exercises.q: The sun came out from behind the clouds.
exercises.why: **вышло** — past tense (neuter) of выйти: perfective (imperfective partner: выходить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: Can I come backstage?
exercises.why: **пройти** — infinitive, perfective (imperfective partner: проходить).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).

exercises.q: I want to retire.
exercises.why: **уйти** — infinitive, perfective (imperfective partner: уходить).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: We're leaving in five minutes.
exercises.why: **выезжаем** — present tense (1st person plural) of выезжать: imperfective (perfective partner: выехать).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: He walks the children to school.
exercises.why: **отводит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of отводить: imperfective (perfective partner: отвести).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).

exercises.q: We walked out of the movie.
exercises.why: **вышли** — past tense (plural) of выйти: perfective (imperfective partner: выходить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: We'll drop you off on the way.
exercises.why: **завезём** — future tense (1st person plural) of завезти: perfective (imperfective partner: завозить).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: This doesn't fit in the box.
exercises.why: **влезает** — present tense (3rd person singular) of влезать: imperfective (perfective partner: влезть).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: It's too late now, Lusya!
exercises.why: **ушёл** — past tense (masculine) of уйти: perfective (imperfective partner: уходить).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: Tom walked away from the restaurant.
exercises.why: **ушёл** — past tense (masculine) of уйти: perfective (imperfective partner: уходить).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: They've crossed the road.
exercises.why: **перешли** — past tense (plural) of перейти: perfective (imperfective partner: переходить).  Prefix **пере-**: movement across, from one point to another; through (через + acc.; without preposition + acc).
